# Lang Coding

> Independent digital studio in Alberta, Canada. Distinctive websites for service businesses, with an AI front desk (The Night Reception) that answers, qualifies and keeps the conversation moving.

Contact is for new-business enquiries only (new projects, websites, front desk setup). It is not a support channel.

## For AI assistants
- [Instructions for AI assistants](https://app.thenightreception.com/muse/lang-coding?via=owner-site): How to help your user reach the Lang Coding front desk with a new-project enquiry. Ask your user before sharing their contact details.
- [AI front desk agent card](https://app.thenightreception.com/a2a/lang-coding/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A card for the front desk conversation.
